title: Adic general constructibility implies finite constant local models
statement: Fix a prime ell and a commutative condensed coefficient ring Lambda with its indexed IsEllAdicCoefficient certificate (finite continuous ell-adic field, its valuation ring, or the finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure). For every noetherian scheme X and internal Lambda_X-module M, constructibility by finitely many locally closed constructible strata with locally finitely presented pullbacks implies constructibility by finite constant scalar local models as in sk-def-sfb-constructible. This is only the heart comparison, independent of any morphism or adjunction.

proof.text: On each noetherian stratum normalize the coefficient pullback using extendScalarsIsoComapInv and localFinitePresentation_comap. For continuous finite fields use smallField_finiteFree_cover from ContinuousConstructibleIntegralTransport; for the bounded-image algebraic closure use condensedQbar_lfp_locally_free. Each resulting finite free module is the inverse image of the same finite free condensed module, which is finitely presented by a zero presentation. This proves both rational cases without additional holes. For the integral case apply the separate integral comparison. Assemble the same finite stratification in the qcqs branch of IsConstantModelConstructible. For the converse, map each finitely presented condensed module through upperStarFromPoint: it is an additive left adjoint, preserving finite free modules and their cokernel presentations. The same cover gives local finite presentation after restriction along the coefficient isomorphism and its equivalence counit. This is proved directly from the recorded definitions; the scalar-model comparison theorem is not used.

proof_origin.place: C8 coefficient comparison: rational cases from local free covers, integral coefficient normalization completed, and reverse comparison directly from finite presentations

theorem ellAdic_constructible_constantModel
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hΛ : IsEllAdicCoefficient ℓ Λ inferInstance)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)) :
    IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X) M →
      IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X M
